basics.title: MBA | Technology Consultant | Business Analyst
basics.summary: As an MBA-qualified Technology and Business Consultant with a background at top-tier firms like EY and AWS, I specialize in bridging the gap between complex business challenges and innovative technology solutions. My passion lies in driving digital transformation and ensuring operational resilience for organizations in high-stakes industries such as Financial Services, FinTech, and SaaS.

Technical SEO: Conducted thorough website audits to reduce page load times and enhance site health.
Systems Analysis: Applied advanced systems engineering methodologies (SSM) to analyze and improve sustainable data center operations.
Strategic Insights: Conducted in-depth stakeholder analysis to identify opportunities for renewable energy integration.
Compliance & Risk: Developed comprehensive reports on infrastructure efficiency and regulatory compliance.
Strategic Requirement Definition: Defined complex functional and non-functional specifications for high-stakes digital banking projects.
Cloud Migration & Risk Mitigation: Orchestrated dependency analysis for large-scale cloud migrations to AWS environments.
Quality Assurance: Led UAT planning and execution across multiple phased rollouts.
Stakeholder Management: Facilitated high-level workshops with business owners, architects, and security leads.
Served as a Cloud security engineer.
Analysed cloud architectures, identity frameworks, and security controls to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.
Partnered with stakeholders to ensure designs met compliance, reliability, and delivery targets.
